title: Hunts FH-049: Server-side claim adapter for the scan landing and the player claim action

source.ref: Unblocks FH-014S (scan route) and FH-016S (player claim action): hunt_claim_apply is service role only, so the route and action need an authorized adapter.

detail: lib/hunts/claim-guard.ts decides (pure): placement exists and is not revoked, the run belongs to the signed-in actor and is active, the run's Hunt is the placement's Hunt, and the claim token is unexpired and bound to that run and placement; the credit is at assurance signed_node, so a staff-verified mission still answers assurance_too_low. lib/hunts/claim-store.ts loads the facts fresh and calls it: loadScanPlacement(placementId) for resolvePlacement, openClaim(actorId, placementId, nowEpoch) for the signed-in landing (run plus a claim token), claimAsPlayer(actorId, {placementId, missionKey, token, idempotencyKey, nowEpoch}) for the POST. Dark behind HUNTS_CLAIMS_ENABLED; signing key HUNTS_PROOF_SECRET. The route and action are FH-014S and FH-016S.
